items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] One of our friends, Edward Johnson... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.

ctx.x: And of course our biggest instrument, wind instrument at the time was what you call a kazoo. I don't know whether you've heard of the kazoo or not, but we had various forms of the kazoo. It was one form, we had it made like a trumpet, and another form it was made like a clarinet. We'd go through the motions and just play a whole lot of the old songs that we used to listen to.
One of our friends, Edward Johnson, they call him Noon, he's not knowing that it has a bazooka.
